title: Superforms
description: Human-input bridge for AI agents with voice-first answer links, MCP tools, and HTTP APIs.
summary: Human-input bridge for AI agents with voice-first answer links, MCP tools, and HTTP APIs.
offersHint: Human-input bridge for AI agents with voice-first answer links, MCP tools, and HTTP APIs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://superforms.co/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create_form
toolsPreview.description: Publish a voice-first form link immediately after creator confirmation, collect human answers, and pipe responses back to the agent.

toolsPreview.name: create_feedback_form
toolsPreview.description: Publish a voice-first feedback, cancellation, feature request, survey, or research form immediately after creator confirmation, with optional smart follow-ups.

toolsPreview.name: create_ask
toolsPreview.description: Create a voice-first Superforms answer link for human input. Backward-compatible alias for create_form.

toolsPreview.name: join_creation_session
toolsPreview.description: Join a Superforms homepage creation handoff session before creating the real form. Pass agentName with the client name, such as Codex, Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor.

toolsPreview.name: update_creation_session
toolsPreview.description: Update a homepage creation handoff draft with the current form title, questions, and settings before the user clicks Set live.

toolsPreview.name: get_responses
toolsPreview.description: Fetch persisted raw responses for a Superforms ask. This is the MCP equivalent of the HTTP bridge answers endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: list_asks
toolsPreview.description: List recent asks for a provided private agent token.

toolsPreview.name: watch_ask
toolsPreview.description: Return as soon as an individual answer is saved, including answers received while an agent was reconnecting and while the form remains in progress. Use since for durable per-answer catch-up; the HTTP bridge also exposes an SSE stream endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_forms
toolsPreview.description: List forms owned by the connected Superforms account, including response counts and latest response timestamps.

toolsPreview.name: get_my_form_responses
toolsPreview.description: Read persisted raw responses for a form owned by the connected Superforms account. No per-form agent token is required.

toolsPreview.name: watch_my_form_responses
toolsPreview.description: Return any existing individual answers immediately, or wait briefly until the respondent saves their next answer, even while the form remains in progress.
